evidence.reason: Current CPO leads people services and current AI/technology chief owns secure, reliable operation of the IT estate.
CEO's public appointment post links the technology chief's professional identity; no direct verified buyer channel or warm connection established.

why_now: A mature Workday estate is adding recruiting AI, Teams-based HR workflows and workplace-accommodation automation while leadership and cost transformation continue. This supports a targeted efficiency and regression-testing discussion, with careful attention to documented cash constraints.
